provenance.why: v12 walked +36 from wherever it stood, and where it stood was the quarry: the walks led away from the forest and it failed while trees stood by the depot (WoodSpot, 2026-11-02: oak logs 3-8 blocks from spawn). v13 goes home first and searches there; only then does it walk out, in steps anchored at the depot so each walk covers new ground.

title: go home for the forest, chop a tree, leave what it gives at the depot
